verdict: Lead volume is healthy and cheap; local reputation and follow-up systems are the weak links holding growth back.
diagnosis: Meta ads produced 298 leads at roughly $27 each this period, well below industry norms — but only 65 reviews were logged despite five-star quality.

signals.headline: 298 leads at $27 each
signals.detail: Meta campaigns delivered strong lead volume this period at a cost well below the $180 legal benchmark.

signals.headline: 681 reviews averaging 5 stars
signals.detail: Reputation is a genuine asset. Only 65 new reviews came in this period despite consistent five-star ratings.

signals.headline: 129 call clicks, zero directions
signals.detail: Prospects are calling, not visiting. The profile is working as a phone funnel, not a foot-traffic driver.

signals.headline: 5,028 clicks, 1,521 landing views
signals.detail: Roughly 70% of ad clicks never reach the landing page. Page speed or redirect issues likely leaking budget.

signals.headline: Only 31 Instagram followers
signals.detail: Organic social presence is negligible. Paid is carrying the entire channel with no owned audience behind it.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Consumer legal leads run $35–$200 on Meta
benchmark.body: Bankruptcy and debt-related leads typically cost $35–$90 per lead. Meta averages around $180 per lead across legal verticals. Your $27 cost per lead this period sits well below both figures.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Late summer debt inquiries stay steady
seasonal.body: Consumer debt and collections legal searches hold steady through August. No major seasonal spike this period, so performance reflects campaign strength rather than tailwinds.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Firms leaning harder on reviews and video
competitor.body: Peer firms are prioritizing Google Business Profile optimization and short video for local consumer outreach. Reviews now materially influence click-through and conversion in local legal search.

recommendations.title: Fix the click-to-landing-page drop-off
recommendations.detail: Two-thirds of paid clicks never load the landing page this period. Consider auditing page speed, mobile rendering, and tracking pixel setup before adding budget.

recommendations.title: Systematize review requests after every resolved case
recommendations.detail: You average five stars but only logged 65 new reviews. Test an automated text-message review ask 48 hours after case close.

recommendations.title: Test short vertical video against the static ad
recommendations.detail: Static creative is driving cheap leads, but peer firms report video lowering cost further. Worth exploring one video variant against the current top performer.
